units: <cite ref="Beitzah 4b:1">Bets. 4ᵇ</cite> top <he>א׳ השתא אשתלאי</he> if I (had given my decision forthwith) I should have made a mistake.
Snh. 107ᵃ א׳ זממא וכ׳ oh that a muzzle had been put on my enemy’s (euphem. for my) mouth! i.e. oh that I never had said this!

senses.gloss: pr. n. f. Ikhu. Taan. 35ᵃ what is thy name? She said, Ikhu.—Said he א׳ נמטו כשוריך oh that thy joists were sufficiently long!
